source.method: straight-line fit to the published characteristic curve over one log H window shared by all three channels, [-2.16, -0.26], on Kodak's printed lux-second axis, anchored at the printed ISO 160 through the ISO 5800 speed point (green and the slower of red and blue, each at minimum density plus 0.15), which sits -0.04 log H from where ISO 160 predicts, a shift of -0.04, which makes the window Kodak's [-2.2, -0.3]

name: Kodak Portra 160
note: Dye gammas are this stock's own, read off its maker's published characteristic curve. Nothing here is measured from a roll.
